_comment: Questions the assistant answers with series, and what the model must be shown for each. Every entry of 'want' must be in the title of a series or dataset shown (case-insensitive). The best-ranked series' title must contain one of 'first', and no series shown may contain any of 'never'. 'prompt' are strings the prompt must carry, such as the years asked. Add a case for every wrong answer a reader reports.

Saya butuh data kredit bank umum untuk UMKM di Jawa Timur, bulanan 2018-2024, beserta kredit macetnya (NPL).
